summary: Five findings are addressed, but the reasonless gate-answer rule remains internally contradictory.

findings.title: Reasonless gate answers still have contradictory rendering rules
findings.detail: Section 4 and G6 say reasonless and legacy gate answers contribute nothing, but §5.1 still says a legacy event reads as an empty reason and is "rendered as a choice with no reason." The stale sentence must be aligned with the single omission rule.
